Shimon Tubul (David-Haim Buskila), son of Rachel and Avraham, was born on 23 Adar I 5763 (25 February 2003). He was the brother of Simcha Ushar, Yosef Shalom, Sara, David, Leah Avigail, Yehudit, Chaim, Hannah and Bat Sheva.

Shimon grew up in a Haredi family in the community of Tal Ziv in the Mateh Binyamin Regional Council. He was a dominant presence at home, and although he was reserved and quiet, his presence was felt at all times. He was very careful to fulfill the commandment to honor his parents and to safeguard the family's dignity, and all his brothers and sisters respected him. Shimon loved them very much, and was especially close to his younger sisters.

As a child he studied at the Hamesilah Talmud Torah in Tal Ziv, and in ninth grade he moved to the small yeshiva Kinyanei HaTorah in Jerusalem. He devoted much effort to Torah study and was beloved by his teachers and by his friends in the study hall.

At the age of seventeen he left the yeshiva and began to work. Wherever he worked, he showed dedication and responsibility and earned great appreciation. After a year he returned to the study hall. He studied the profession of ritual slaughter, with all the halakhot relating to it, at the Binyan Olam yeshiva in Tal Ziv, and completed his studies with distinction. He then went on to study at a large yeshiva: first at Brit Yaakov in Jerusalem (the first shiur) and afterward at a large yeshiva in Beit Shean (the second shiur).

During yeshiva vacations he hiked with his friends along the trails of Israel. He especially loved to immerse himself in springs and to swim. When he came home for vacations, he would help with household chores and enjoyed trying his hand at small repairs, such as installing shelves and painting.

On Shabbat, 22 Tishrei, Simchat Torah 5784, 7 October 2023, at half past six in the morning, the terrorist organization Hamas launched a surprise attack on Israel. Under cover of massive fire of missiles and rockets from the Gaza Strip into wide areas of the country, thousands of terrorists infiltrated by land, sea and air, and began a murderous assault on the communities of the Gaza envelope and on Sderot, Ofakim and Netivot, on the Nova music festival site near the kibbutzim Re'im and Nir Oz, on IDF bases and on travelers on the roads in the area. The terrorists murdered some eight hundred civilians in their homes and in their cars, after committing grave atrocities against them. They abducted hundreds of Israelis to the Gaza Strip, and destroyed, looted and set fire to homes and property. Hundreds of soldiers, police officers, security personnel and members of local emergency squads fell in battle. On that morning, a war began.

After the war broke out, Shimon resolved in his heart to serve as a combat soldier in the army.

On 9 May 2024 he enlisted in the IDF. He began his service as a combat soldier in the Netzah Yehuda Brigade, but because of a surgery he had undergone, which took a physical toll on him, he was unable to complete basic training. Consequently, he was assigned to the Hasmonean Brigade (Brigade 613), an infantry brigade established after the outbreak of the war specifically for Haredi soldiers. Shimon served in the company commander's command post as a personal driver. He fulfilled his role with dedication and responsibility and earned great appreciation.

On Wednesday, 30 April 2025, while on leave from the army, Shimon was killed in a traffic accident near Ma'ale Mishmash in Binyamin.

Staff Sergeant Shimon Tubul fell on Tuesday, 3 Iyar 5785 (30 April 2025). He was twenty-two years old when he fell. He was laid to rest in the Bu'eine cemetery. He is survived by his parents, three brothers and six sisters.

After his death he was posthumously promoted to the rank of Sergeant.
